dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Maybe... I should attend an advanced cultivation session...

choices.text: Chongyun, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: A gift envelope? Thank you, I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Apologies... I've been busy recently, so I don't have one for you in return... All I can do is offer you my wishes in person.

choices.text: I wish you all the best, as well.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Yes... Considering my family, I have some understanding of exorcisms and demons. But, I'm ashamed to say I never anticipated the connection between Xingqiu's great-grandfather and the problem with the boundary of life and death.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If I had more knowledge, or noticed something earlier, maybe you and Hu Tao wouldn't have needed to take those risks.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I should attend an advanced cultivation session soon...

choices.text: But, don't worry. It's been a busy time...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Bye! I wish you all the best in the coming year.
